question: Where is the breath-filled vital air said to be situated among living beings?
premises: The subject is the breath-filled vital air.
Its location is in all living beings.
inference: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement of saṃsthitam (neuter) with vāyuḥ (masculine) may reflect textual transmission.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
